WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track AS t
  INNER JOIN MediaType AS mt
    ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    media_type_name,
    rate,
    track_count,
    AVG(rate) OVER () AS mean_rate
  FROM per_media_type
)
SELECT
  media_type_name AS name,
  rate,
  track_count,
  rate - mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE rate > mean_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A track with NULL Bytes has a missing ratio and is skipped by AVG; a zero Milliseconds value also yields a missing ratio. The media type's track count still includes those tracks, and types with no nonmissing ratios have a NULL rate and are excluded from the mean.
